connectorUiConfig.title: Google Workspace Alert Center (using Sentinel Connector Builder Agent)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The Google Workspace connector ingests Alert Center alerts (phishing, DLP, device compromise, state-sponsored attacks, and suspicious activity) from Google Workspace into Microsoft Sentinel.

Supports OAuth2 authentication.

For more information, visit [Google Workspace Alert Center API](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/alertcenter/reference/rest).

graphQueries.baseQuery: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

sampleQueries.description: All alerts from the last 24 hours

sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | summarize count() by MetadataSeverity | order by count_ desc
{{graphQueriesTableName}} | summarize count() by AlertType | order by count_ desc

sampleQueries.description: High severity alerts in the last 7 days
sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where MetadataSeverity == 'HIGH' | project TimeGenerated, AlertId, AlertType, Source, MetadataStatus, MetadataAssignee

sampleQueries.description: Open (not closed) alerts grouped by source
sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where MetadataStatus != 'CLOSED' | summarize count() by Source | order by count_ desc

customs.name: Google Workspace OAuth Application
customs.description: An OAuth2 application must be registered in Google Cloud Console with the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.alerts` scope authorized. Client ID and Client Secret are required. See [Alert Center API documentation](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/alertcenter/reference/rest) for setup instructions.

instructionSteps.title: Step 1 - Register an OAuth2 application in Google Cloud Console
instructionSteps.description:
1. Go to the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/) and select or create a project.
2. Enable the **Google Workspace Alert Center API** for the project.
3. Configure the OAuth consent screen and add the scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.alerts`.
4. Under **APIs & Services > Credentials**, create an **OAuth 2.0 Client ID** (Web application).
5. Add the following Authorized redirect URI: `https://portal.azure.com/TokenAuthorize/ExtensionName/Microsoft_Azure_Security_Insights`.
6. Copy the generated **Client ID** and **Client Secret** for use in the next step.

For more information, see the [Alert Center API documentation](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/alertcenter/reference/rest).

instructionSteps.title: Step 2 - Connect to Google Workspace Alert Center
instructionSteps.description: Provide the OAuth2 Client ID, Client Secret, and Authorization Code from your Google Cloud OAuth application, then click **Connect** to authorize access and begin ingesting alerts.
